summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its board's approval of an interest on capital (IoC) distribution of R$600 million gross (R$495 million net after 17.5% withholding tax), or R$0.18775779427 per share (net R$0.15490018027). The distribution uses the April 30, 2026 balance sheet and will be paid by April 30, 2027, with the ex-IoC date set as May 27, 2026. Amounts will be allocated toward the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026, subject to shareholder approval at the 2027 AGM. This is a routine capital return—not a special situation—and is equivalent to a US dividend declaration.
